moa: Atypical antipsychotic: serotonin 5-HT2A receptor antagonist with dopamine D2 receptor presynaptic partial agonist and postsynaptic antagonist activity

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 209500 NDA APPROVAL Intra-Cellular Therapies, Inc. ... Caplyta (lumateperone) capsules ... It is approved, effective on the date of this letter

revenue_scope: U.S. net product sales: Intra-Cellular Therapies' 'Product sales, net' (its only product line, CAPLYTA, sold in the U.S.) through 2024Q4, then Johnson & Johnson's CAPLYTA US row (Intl row nil) from 2025Q2
series_start_reason: 2020Q1 is the first quarter of sales: the 2020Q1 release states net product sales of approximately $882,500 and that none were reported for the comparable period of 2019. J&J acquired Intra-Cellular Therapies on April 2, 2025 (schedule footnote (5)); 2025Q2 is the first J&J schedule that prints a CAPLYTA line.

unreported_quarters.2025Q1: No document prints the quarter: Intra-Cellular Therapies was acquired on 2025-04-02 before reporting 2025Q1 and filed no 2025Q1 results; Johnson & Johnson's 2Q25 schedule prints CAPLYTA 'SIX MONTHS' 2025 as 211, equal to the second-quarter figure, because the product is consolidated only from April 2, 2025.

notes: Issuer column marks who reported each row. Same scope across the join: both lines are U.S. CAPLYTA net product sales (ITCI sold only in the U.S.; J&J's Intl row is a dash). 2020Q1-2021Q3 come from the 10-Q MD&A tables in thousands (the releases and statements print whole dollars: 2020Q1 882,516; 2020Q2 1,875,889; 2020Q3 7,368,594), so those rows carry up to 0.001M truncation/rounding versus the dollar figures. 2020Q4 is the release text figure 12.4 (dollars 12,403,754 are printed only in whole-dollar statements). 2021Q4 is the prior-year column of the 2022 release (thousands) because the 2021Q4 release prints whole dollars. 2022Q1-2024Q4 are the quarters' own releases. Annual checks: 2022 quarters sum to 249.132 (printed 249,132); 2023 sum 462.175 (printed 462,175); 2024 sum 680.501 (printed 680,501); 2021 sum 81.708 (printed 81,708). The 2024Q4 release restates 2023Q4 as 131,507 (own 2023 release: 131,506). J&J: 2025Q2-Q4 sum to 700 (211+240+249), the twelve-month column in the 4Q25 schedule; 2026Q1 270 plus 2026Q2 361 equals the 631 six-month column in the 2Q26 schedule. J&J's 10-K FY2025 XBRL tags CAPLYTA revenue with a US-country member only.
